name: LocalAI
summary: Self-hosted drop-in OpenAI API replacement running local GGUF chats, Flux/SD images & offline voice cloning cleanly inside Docker.
ranking_rationale: Single self-hosted local container serves chat, image gen, embeddings & TTS privately (trade-off: config YAML tuning demands moderate dev familiarity vs turnkey Ollama).

pricing.notes: Pricing and promos change frequently; verify directly at official checkout.

pros: Single self-hosted local container serves chat, image gen, embeddings & TTS privately
100% local & offline with zero cloud telemetry or censorship filters
cons: Config YAML tuning demands moderate dev familiarity vs turnkey Ollama
Image/voice backends consume substantial VRAM simultaneously
